purpose: Keep the numeric geometry and gates used by the ST052-M outer-reservoir nonlinear screen separate from qualitative OpenAI public observables and from PDE acceptance.

public_observable_authority.head: a6d713e3679024d58f2650e0a75ef2092a8dddff
public_observable_authority.note: This audit does not re-create the public-source contract or assume its queued CI has passed. It only prevents PR #775 project-chosen numeric probes from masquerading as public OpenAI numbers.

user_requirement: Deliver an explicit callable/saveable 3D time-varying velocity field whose publicly observable structure is made as consistent as practicable with the public OpenAI velocity-field visualization.
public_source_fact: The official-public observable contract records inward-spiraling trajectories as a qualitative observation with no numerical target.
The official-public observable contract records axial stretching/elongation as a qualitative observation with no numerical target.
autonomous_design: Calling 1<abs(z)<1.8 the visualization-relevant visible tip lobe for this development screen.
Using abs(z)=1.55 and 1.75 as visible-tip probe bands.
Using abs(z)=1.85 and 1.95 as outer-reservoir diagnostic bands.
Using radii 0.6, 0.9, 1.2, four cardinal azimuths, and times 0.375, 0.50, 0.625, 0.75.
Requiring the reservoir-child mean cylindrical radial velocity to be negative and strictly below both #652 and the frozen #740 p=9 child at every selected visible-tip band/time.
Using historical #701 development positions at t=0.50 to derive the single reservoir coefficient.
Using #652 and #740 as project-selected development comparators.
pending_unknown: Exact mapping from public-render image locations to repository x/y/z coordinates.
Whether repository abs(z)=1.55 or 1.75 corresponds to any particular OpenAI-render location.
Absolute public spatial scale and coordinate registration.
Color transfer function and rendering normalization.
Hidden OpenAI velocity samples, coefficients, pressure, and forcing.
